mapper.select: SELECT r.org_unit_id AS unitId, o.unit_type AS unitType, o.code AS unitCode, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(r.rating = 'DAT_VUOT') AS achieved, SUM(r.rating = 'CHUA_DAT') AS notAchieved, SUM(r.rating = 'DANG_THEO_DOI') AS tracking, SUM(r.rating = 'CHUA_DAT' OR (r.completion_rate IS NOT NULL AND r.completion_rate < #{warningRate})) AS warning, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completion_rate IS NOT NULL THEN r.completion_rate * COALESCE(d.weight, 1) END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.completion_rate IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(d.weight, 1) END), 0) AS completionRate, SUM(CASE WHEN r.score IS NOT NULL THEN r.score * COALESCE(d.weight, 1) END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.score IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(d.weight, 1) END), 0) AS bscScore FROM evaluation_result r JOIN evaluation_kpi ek ON ek.id = r.evaluation_kpi_id JOIN kpi k ON k.id = ek.kpi_id JOIN org_unit o ON o.id = r.org_unit_id LEFT JOIN kpi_assignment_detail d ON d.id = r.assignment_detail_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND ek.deleted = 0 AND ek.year = #{year} AND ek.period_code = #{period} AND k.parent_id IS NULL GROUP BY r.org_unit_id, o.unit_type, o.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bsc_unit_summary (org_unit_id, year, period_code, total_kpi, achieved, not_achieved, tracking, warning, completion_rate, bsc_score, computed_at) VALUES (#{unitId}, #{year}, #{period}, #{total}, #{achieved}, #{notAchieved}, #{tracking}, #{warning}, #{completionRate}, #{bscScore}, NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_kpi = VALUES(total_kpi), achieved = VALUES(achieved), not_achieved = VALUES(not_achieved), tracking = VALUES(tracking), warning = VALUES(warning), completion_rate = VALUES(completion_rate), bsc_score = VALUES(bsc_score), computed_at = NOW(3)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bsc_unit_summary WHERE year = #{year} AND period_code = #{period} AND org_unit_id NOT IN #{i}
mapper.select: SELECT s.org_unit_id AS unitId, o.code AS unitCode, o.name AS unitName, o.unit_type AS unitType, o.parent_id AS parentId, o.level, s.total_kpi AS totalKpi, s.achieved, s.not_achieved AS notAchieved, s.tracking, s.warning, s.completion_rate AS completionRate, s.bsc_score AS bscScore, s.rank_in_group AS rankInGroup, s.rank_group AS rankGroup, s.prev_bsc_score AS prevBscScore, s.prev_rank AS prevRank, s.computed_at AS computedAt FROM bsc_unit_summary s JOIN org_unit o ON o.id = s.org_unit_id WHERE s.year = #{year} AND s.period_code = #{period} ORDER BY o.level, o.sort_order, o.code
mapper.update: UPDATE bsc_unit_summary SET rank_in_group = #{rank}, rank_group = #{group}, prev_bsc_score = #{prevScore}, prev_rank = #{prevRank} WHERE year = #{year} AND period_code = #{period} AND org_unit_id = #{unitId}
mapper.select: SELECT o.code AS unitCode, o.name AS unitName, COUNT(*) AS pending FROM evaluation_result r JOIN evaluation_kpi ek ON ek.id = r.evaluation_kpi_id JOIN org_unit o ON o.id = r.org_unit_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND ek.year = #{year} AND ek.period_code = #{period} AND (r.status NOT IN ('DA_CO_KQ','DA_XU_LY_DIEU_CHINH','CHOT_DANH_GIA','TGD_DA_DUYET') OR (r.final_result IS NULL AND r.score IS NULL)) GROUP BY o.id, o.code, o.name ORDER BY o.level, o.sort_order, o.code

SELECT o.code AS unitCode, o.name AS unitName, COUNT(*) AS pending FROM evaluation_result r JOIN evaluation_kpi ek ON ek.id = r.evaluation_kpi_id JOIN org_unit o ON o.id = r.org_unit_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND ek.year = #{year} AND ek.period_code = #{period} AND r.status NOT IN ('CHOT_DANH_GIA','TGD_DA_DUYET') GROUP BY o.id, o.code, o.name ORDER BY o.level, o.sort_order, o.code

SELECT id, year, period_code AS periodCode, status, closed_by AS closedBy, closed_at AS closedAt, approved_by AS approvedBy, approved_at AS approvedAt FROM period_closing WHERE year = #{year} AND period_code = #{period}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO period_closing (year, period_code, status, closed_by, closed_at, snapshot, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{year}, #{period}, 'CHOT', #{by}, NOW(3), #{snapshot}, #{by}, #{by}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'CHOT', closed_by = #{by}, closed_at = NOW(3), snapshot = #{snapshot}, updated_at = NOW(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE period_closing SET status = 'TGD_DA_DUYET', approved_by = #{by}, approved_at = NOW(3), updated_by = #{by}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE year = #{year} AND period_code = #{period}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.org_unit_id FROM evaluation_result r JOIN evaluation_kpi ek ON ek.id = r.evaluation_kpi_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND ek.year = #{year} AND ek.period_code = #{period}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_result r JOIN evaluation_kpi ek ON ek.id = r.evaluation_kpi_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND ek.year = #{year} AND ek.period_code = #{period}
